title: Martinfish Just Got WORSE
summary: Martinfish (Stockfish x Martin, by wintrcat) at a 90:10 ratio: 90% top engine move, 10% Martin move, chosen randomly and hidden. Player takes BLACK this time (Caro-Kann/Slav). Early Qf3 looks like a Martin move; the bot otherwise plays sound moves and builds pressure; player misses a rook pin tactic but survives, and wins with a checking sequence ending in mate ('by the skin of our teeth we did defeat Martin fish').
rules: Each bot move: 90% Stockfish top move, 10% a Martin (≈250 Elo) move; random and not revealed.
